name: Tehinna
title: Father of Ir-Nahasj
summary: Tehinna is a person mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. He is the son of Eshton and is described as the father of Ir-Nahasj (the city of Nahash). He is one of the lesser-known figures in the Bible, primarily known through his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Tehinna is mentioned as the son of Eshton in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. He is described as the father of Ir-Nahasj (the city of copper).

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Eshton
keyEvents.description: Tehinna is part of Eshton's family line along with his brothers Bet-Rafa and Paseah, all of whom are mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Founding of Ir-Nahasj
keyEvents.description: Tehinna is linked to the founding or leadership of the city Ir-Nahasj, which means 'City of Copper' or 'City of Serpent', suggesting a possible connection to copper working.

keyEvents.title: Part of the inheritance of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: As part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, Tehinna is placed in the broader context of Israel's tribal history and God's promises to Judah.
